# BuildCalc

> Free calculators and tools across 50 categories, including Finance, Construction, Math, Health and Fitness, Cooking and Kitchen, Business, Travel, Education, Sports, Technology, Real Estate, Energy and Environment, Food and Nutrition, Baby and Family, Automotive, Career, Shopping, Games, Music, Weather, Conversion, Everyday Life, Science, Pet, Time and Date, and many tool categories. Every calculator page shows its formula, and many show a worked example. Results are estimates and general information only, not financial, legal, tax or medical advice.
